content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments means bypassing traditional payment processors and their exorbitant fees. Platforms like Gumroad take a hefty 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments with COREMERCH allows creators to retain 99.5% of their earnings, making it a financially savvy choice. This approach not only enables creators to maintain more of their hard-earned money but also empowers them to take control of their digital commerce without the constraints imposed by third-party services.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure of a sovereign commerce stack focuses on ownership and autonomy. By deploying solutions like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic, creators can build a fully operational online store. Each transaction is processed through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture ensures that all transactions are transparent, secure, and instantaneous, allowing creators to deliver their products automatically without intermediary delays.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators across various regions facing payment restrictions. Whether you’re selling beats, templates, or ebooks, COREMERCH provides the tools to operate independently from platforms that impose high fees and ownership limitations. By using our systems, creators can focus on their craft while enjoying the financial benefits of direct transactions, making it ideal for those looking to thrive in the digital economy.
Eliminate platform fees and retain more of your earnings with a sovereign commerce stack.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is comprised of essential tools that integrate seamlessly. At its core, you have GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store, Google Sheets or Supabase for managing orders, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. This combination ensures that creators have complete control over their data and transactions, fostering an environment of sovereignty and independence that traditional platforms can’t provide.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the right stack for your needs, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, both of which can be deployed in just 48 hours. Next, set up your hosting environment on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your order management system using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, load your products and go live. For a comprehensive blueprint, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a sovereign commerce stack that incorporates crypto payment processing. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, you can accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This setup ensures you keep more of your earnings and maintain full control over your digital products.
Ownership of your infrastructure means no third-party restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
